Greentech Professionals SRL – Privacy Policy Last updated: June 2026

1. About Us

This Privacy Policy describes how Greentech Professionals SRL collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you visit greentechpro.ro or interact with us through this website.

Data Controller: Greentech Professionals SRL, 194 Calea Floreasca, Sector 1, 014472, Bucharest, Romania. Email: office@greentechpro.ro. Phone: +40 727 332 213.

We process personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and applicable Romanian law.

2. What Data We Collect

We collect only the personal data that you voluntarily provide to us through the application form on our “Careers” page. This includes: your full name, email address, phone number, desired position, professional experience, and any resume or reference documents you upload.

If you contact us directly at office@greentechpro.ro, we process only the information included in your email. We do not use tracking pixels, analytics tools, or any other method of automated data collection on this website.

3. How We Use Your Data

The data submitted via the form on the “Careers” page is used exclusively to evaluate your application for current or future job openings, to contact you regarding your application, and to maintain internal records of the recruitment process. We will not use your data for marketing purposes or for any other purpose without your explicit consent.

4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your data based on your explicit consent (Article 6(1)(a) of the GDPR), which you provide when you check the GDPR checkbox on the application form. You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us at office@greentechpro.ro. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal.

5. How Long We Retain Your Data

Data from the job application is retained for a maximum period of 12 months from the date of submission. After this period, it is permanently deleted, unless you have been hired, in which case your data is retained as part of your employment file, in accordance with applicable labor laws. You may request the deletion of your data at any time.

6. Who We Share Your Data With

We do not sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. Your data may be accessed by internal staff in the human resources and management departments involved in the recruitment process, as well as by our website hosting service provider, which acts as a data processor within the European Economic Area (EEA). We do not transfer data outside the EEA.

7. Your Rights

In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or transfer your personal data, as well as to object to its processing. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at office@greentechpro.ro. We will respond within 30 days.

You may also file a complaint with the ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro), the Romanian data protection supervisory authority, located at 28-30 General Gheorghe Magheru Blvd., Sector 1, Bucharest.

8. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure. All data transmissions on this website are encrypted via HTTPS.

9. Cookies

This website uses only essential technical cookies, which are necessary for its proper functioning. We do not use tracking, advertising, or analytics cookies. Essential cookies do not require consent under applicable EU law.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the last revision is displayed at the top of this page. Your continued use of the website following any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

items.question: What types of projects do you undertake?
items.answer:
We perform electrical, mechanical, and civil engineering work for photovoltaic parks, wind power infrastructure, technical installations, and data centers.

The exact scope of work is determined after analyzing the documentation and the site.

items.question: In which countries do you operate?
items.answer: We have experience working in Romania, Italy, and Spain. For other locations within the European Union, mobilization is evaluated based on the duration, scope, and requirements of the project.

items.question: Can you handle multiple phases of the same project?
items.answer: Yes. We can handle mechanical assembly, wiring, electrical installations, testing, and maintenance. Responsibilities are clearly defined before work begins.

items.question: What certifications do you hold?
items.answer: The company holds ISO certifications and ANRE accreditation for activities in the energy sector. Documents relevant to the project can be provided upon request.

items.question: How is the mobilization deadline determined?
items.answer: The start date is determined after evaluating the site, the scope of work, and the team’s availability. For each request, we provide a realistic timeline before confirming the project.

items.question: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Please use the form to provide the location, estimated capacity, type of work, and desired timeframe. We will get back to you with the technical questions needed to finalize the quote and schedule.
